I have a Bachelor's degree in Physics and an MA in Philosophy. Currently I am a PhD student in Philosophy at the University of Bucharest (Department of Theoretical Philosophy and Logic). My research is in the philosophy of language, philosophy of mind, and philosophy of AI. I can be reached at florin at antimaterie.ro
